coverage.reason: The standalone gallery reviews all twenty original paintings and five level ranges before production optimization. Its browser validator checks order/stage mappings, transparent assets, outside-wall medieval scenery, camp provenance, growth/comparison/160px views, keyboard controls and desktop/landscape/portrait layouts, including Full/Pause/Subtle/Off and reduced motion. The runtime adapter uses the same drawing routines and is separately covered below. Source PNGs and gallery files remain excluded from production.

Document the owner-confirmed four permanent 600-Crown skins, five established progression appearances, free Apply, runtime performance controls and rollout boundary. Prose does not execute; catalog, ownership, stage mapping and deployment capability behavior are exercised by the integration groups below.

The isolated Chromium encoder creates the twenty lazy-loaded runtime WebPs from the reviewed masters. Unit validation verifies every source/output hash, catalog path, unique stage, WebP alpha and dimensions, and per-order byte budget. Browser integration decodes all stages in the game; artifact validation verifies shipping and exclusion from install precaching. The encoder reuses existing isolated browser/server helpers without changing them.

Shared client/server catalog adds four 600-Crown offers and the load response advertises backend support. Unit tests cover prices, ownership, seasons and all stage assets. Emulator coverage exercises authoritative transactions, concurrent idempotent receipts, wrong-price/unowned/duplicate rejection, balances, explicit Apply and public equipment visibility while preserving Halloween availability, retired entitlements, pickup claims and private-data rules. Browser tests cover rollout gating and four purchases/Apply actions using the same catalog. The shared collectHarvestBonus callable must retain every knight entitlement and equipped skin after Crown collection; the emulator explicitly covers this dependency. Live Crown checkout only merges balance/revision fields and is unchanged.

Shared Shop/My Skins/map rendering adds knight previews and bounded canvas motion alongside Halloween. Browser checks cover all four prices/purchases, explicit Apply, twenty stages and boundary levels, owner/capture/default/stronghold/missing-art behavior, old-backend offer gating, desktop and short landscape layouts and existing retry/flag behavior. Existing Halloween and motion suites guard shared scheduler/regression dependencies. The 60-city stress fixture measures Off versus Full under 4x CPU slowdown, slots, paint frequency, buffer bytes, camera/overlay/visibility/preferences/offscreen stop-resume and removing the final layer. Checked-in results are local evidence, not a universal phone performance guarantee.

The game entry loads the bounded painter before the skins UI, and cache revisions ship the updated catalog/renderer. Build and artifact checks ensure runtime modules and twenty WebPs ship while source galleries stay out, with explicit module/art budgets and no new art precache. Shared asset-budget and PWA-routing checks guard shell size, cache consistency and installed entry behavior; the real-game browser test proves load order and runtime integration.
